description: RELATIVE volume DECREASE for the ceiling speakers. Use this for EVERY 'volume down', 'quieter', 'turn it down', 'lower the volume', or 'down by N percent' request. Default lowers by 10%; pass step=N to lower by N%. Do NOT use 'Set Volume' for these and do NOT compute a new absolute number.

step.description: How many percent to lower by (default 10).
step.name: Step percent
